hooks.command: if [ "$(uname)" = Darwin ]; then f=/tmp/atlagsebesseg-caffeinate.pid; if [ -f "$f" ] && kill -0 "$(cat "$f")" 2>/dev/null; then :; else nohup caffeinate -dims >/dev/null 2>&1 </dev/null & echo $! > "$f"; fi; fi; exit 0
f=/tmp/atlagsebesseg-caffeinate.pid; if [ -f "$f" ]; then kill "$(cat "$f")" 2>/dev/null; rm -f "$f"; fi; exit 0
